title: Symmetry of the second derivative of a C² map (Schwarz)
statement: For all n, N ∈ ℕ, every f : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ (ℝ^d := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) and every x ∈ ℝⁿ such that f is C² at x (ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x), the second derivative L := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x is symmetric: L a b = L b a for all a, b ∈ ℝⁿ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn N) (x : Rn n), ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x → ∀ a b : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x a b = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x b a
